rounds.name: Brittany Peninsula
rounds.fact: Brittany is a rugged peninsula extending from western France into the Atlantic Ocean toward the Celtic Sea.

rounds.name: Gulf of Suez
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Suez is a gulf at the northern end of the Red Sea, leading into the southern terminus of the Suez Canal.

rounds.name: Aleutian Islands
rounds.fact: The volcanic Aleutian Islands extend westward from the Alaska Peninsula into the northern Pacific Ocean toward the Kamchatka Peninsula.

rounds.name: Korean Strait / Busan
rounds.fact: The Korea Strait is a sea passage between South Korea and Japan, connecting the East China Sea and the Sea of Japan.

rounds.name: Bass Strait
rounds.fact: Bass Strait is a strait separating the island state of Tasmania from the Australian mainland state of Victoria.
